ocr_model.supplied_regions: Saved model predictions from our D-FINE epoch 14 checkpoint; no reference annotations.
ocr_model.line_decoder: Native DETECT_STRAIGHT_LINES_IN_REGIONS, with native assign_lines_to_regions clipping.
ocr_model.ocr_crop_policy: PERO baseline/height crops from a page masked white outside each parent D-FINE region.
stages: Native line decoding independently inside fixed D-FINE regions
Native smart region order applied to IDs only; its rotation round-trip is isolated on a copy
